_comment: tool-integrations/1 example. A CLI integration has no configured role list: local_cli automatically participates in Planner, Generator, and Evaluator under framework-owned role contracts. a2a_targets add only Planner/Evaluator because remote Generator source handoff is not defined yet.

integrations.label: Claude Code
integrations.notes: The framework fixes the role persona to planner-proposal, generator-restricted, or evaluator. Coordinator remains outside this catalog.

integrations.label: Codex
integrations.notes: One verified Codex integration. The framework applies proposal-only, source-handoff, or verdict-only limits according to the dispatched role.

a2a_targets.notes: Start the self-hosted runner with --integration claude-code --runner-id claude-code-loopback. Dispatch requires valid scoped Claude credentials on the runner host.
Start the self-hosted runner with --integration codex --runner-id codex-loopback. This target is offered for Planner and Evaluator only.
Start the self-hosted runner with --integration kimi --runner-id kimi-loopback.
